chunks: 3871 - And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ruled that there should be, between the two canals in width, if it is soft land, a distance of one thousand cubits between them; and if it is hard land, there should be five hundred cubits between them.

key_terms.أَرْضًا رِخْوَةً: soft land, which requires a wider separation
key_terms.أَرْضًا صُلْبَةً: hard or firm land, which allows a smaller separation
key_terms.أَلْفُ ذِرَاعٍ: one thousand cubits, the prescribed distance in soft land
key_terms.خَمْسُمِائَةِ ذِرَاعٍ: five hundred cubits, the prescribed distance in hard land
key_terms.قَضَى: he ruled or judged with binding legal force
key_terms.ٱلْعَرْضِ: the lateral distance or width between the two canals
key_terms.ٱلْقَنَاتَيْنِ: the two canals or underground water channels whose spacing is being regulated

ai.seo_question: What distance did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم set between two canals in soft and hard land?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the required spacing between two canals. The prescribed distance varies according to the nature of the land: a greater distance for soft ground and a lesser distance for hard ground, reflecting practical regulation of water rights and land use.
